{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the presence of 'refunded' status
print("Unique values in status:", sales['status'].unique())

# Check for the presence of the QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for the number of completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']
print(f"Total completed orders: {len(completed_orders)}")

# Check the first few revenue values to confirm format
print("First 5 revenue values (as string):", sales['revenue'].head().tolist())"}
